name: selection-toolbar

frames.best_why: Frame 6 is the only frame that shows the floating toolbar with all five actions above a selection.

tagline: Select text and a small icon toolbar pops up above the highlighted words.
summary: A floating formatting bar that appears whenever text is selected inside an editable area. It offers bold, italic, link, copy and share actions, follows the selection and stays inside the viewport.
appearance: A dark, rounded editor card holds a white heading and two grey paragraphs of body text. Selected words get a translucent highlight, and a compact dark strip of five small line icons appears above, with a thin divider after the first three.
behaviour: Selecting text inside the card opens a small toolbar just above the highlight; it flips and shifts to stay on screen and closes on Escape, a click elsewhere or when the selection clears. The icons act on the chosen words.
demo_content: Editable card titled 'Writing release notes people read' with two paragraphs about writing good release notes.
search_phrases: highlight text and show bold italic options
copy and share selected text popup
small icon bar pops up on highlight
use_when: Editable article text needs quick bold, link, copy and share actions right where the user selected something.
avoid_when: It watches one container via the browser selection API, so shadow DOM or cross-node selections can misplace it.
customise: Placement side, offsets, collision handling, open state, selection callback and the container are props; the action buttons are composed as children and their behaviour is yours.
weight_why: A tiny floating strip of five buttons; work happens only on selection events.

a11y.note: The bar is labelled and Escape closes it, but it opens only from a mouse selection and its icon buttons carry no individual labels.

issues: When the selection sits near the top the toolbar overlaps the heading above it.
polish_why: The floating behaviour and styling are tidy; the bar is a standard icon strip with no labels.
